headline: Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon 2026 Boosts Magelang Local Economy
metaDescription: The 2026 Borobudur Marathon attracted 12,500 runners from 38 countries, significantly boosting local tourism and revenue for Magelang businesses.
aiSummaryBullets: The 2026 Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon attracted 12,500 participants from 38 different nations.
Local small and medium-sized enterprises experienced a notable increase in earnings during the event period.
Government officials highlighted the marathon as a significant contributor to regional tourism and community development.
aiContextParagraph: The Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon 2026 has concluded in Central Java, drawing a diverse crowd of 12,500 runners representing 38 countries. Beyond its role as a competitive sporting event, the marathon is positioned as a primary driver for the regional economy, particularly in Magelang. Local businesses, including small and medium-sized enterprises (UMKM) and hospitality providers, reported increased activity as a direct result of the influx of visitors. Public officials, including Central Java Governor Ahmad Luthfi and Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Bima Arya Sugiarto, participated in or acknowledged the event, emphasizing its importance in fostering communal solidarity and promoting sport tourism. The event reflects ongoing efforts to integrate major athletic competitions with broader economic development strategies within the region, ensuring that international sports gatherings serve as an effective platform for local prosperity and regional tourism expansion.
